name: band-rehearsal-helper
description: A lightweight web utility designed for musical bands to manage repertoire, view chords, and rehearse efficiently.

paragraphs: A lightweight, no-build web utility designed for musical bands to manage repertoire, view chords, and rehearse efficiently. This tool uses a publicly accessible Google Sheet as a database, making it easy to update song lists without touching the code.
features: No-Build & Serverless: Pure HTML/JS/CSS. No complex build steps or backend servers required.
Google Sheets as DB: Manage your songs in a spreadsheet; updates are reflected instantly in the app.
Smart Chord Parsing: Supports dynamic chord parsing from text, allowing for future transposition features.

Pinned Songs: Songs marked PinedByDefault in the sheet are pinned to the top of the list for everyone. Anyone can locally pin/unpin any song from the UI — this only changes sort order for you, it's never written back to…

Favorites & Setlists: Star any song locally to build your own setlist — this is what the prev/next navigation on a song page cycles through. Until you star anything, prev/next falls back to the pinned songs by default.

requirements.text: Admin Mode (Google Sign-In): Sign in with Google; if your account has edit access to the sheet, an "Add Song" button and a per-song edit (pencil) icon appear, letting you create/update songs directly from the app.
